description: Check availability and USD price for a name across TLDs. Prices are decimal USD strings: price_usd (= total_usd, what you pay today for `years`, e.g. 2 years for .ai), year1_usd and renewal_usd; renewal_price, renews_at_usd, per_year_usd and first_year_usd are deprecated aliases. premium (boolean) flags registry premium names. Results with checking:true or price_confirmed:false are still being confirmed: poll again after retry_after_ms. If the name is taken, suggestions[] lists close AVAILABLE alternatives (live-checked, lowest price first).
name: search_domains
title: Search domain availability
